description: A half-open span of one input text used by a TextDiffHunk. Offsets are CHARACTER offsets into the corresponding input (OldText for the old side, NewText for the new side), independent of the TextDiffGranularity: a word diff and a line diff both report character offsets, so a consumer can slice the original text — or scroll a viewer — without re-running the engine.

members.name: End
members.description: Offset one past the last covered character.

members.name: IsEmpty
members.description: Whether the span covers no character at all.

members.name: Length
members.description: Number of characters covered; 0 for the empty side of an insertion or deletion.

members.name: Start
members.description: Zero-based offset of the first character covered by the span.
